sentences.text:
Krishna Devi And Another Vs. Rishi Pal And Others
Present:- Mr. Raj Kapoor Malik, Advocate for the appellants.

Mr. Paul S. Saini, Advocate and  Mr. Sandeep Suri, Advocate along with  Ms. Suman, Manager and  Mr. Vivek Suman, AM  for National Ins. Co. Ltd.
 ***

This appeal has been filed by the appellants against the award dated 17.07.2015 of Rs.6,92,760/-
passed by learned MACT, Kaithal, seeking enhancement of compensation.

The Insurance Company has also filed the appeal (FAO-7544-2015) against the said award claiming that the compensation awarded in favour of the claimants is too high as the claim petition was filed under Section 163-A of the Motor Vehicle Act.
The service of proforma respondent No.5-Malkit Kaur (who was ex-parte) was dispensed with vide order dated 07.09.2016 passed by this Hon'ble High Court.

The Hon'ble High Court vide its order dated 06.11.2015 ordered that on deposit of Rs.4,60,000/- by the Insurance Company-appellant within four weeks from today, recovery of the remaining amount shall remain stayed.

As agreed, as per statement of the representatives of the Insurance Company and counsel for the appellants, (separately recorded today), a sum of Rs.1,50,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Fifty Thousand only) over and above Rs.4,60,000/- is allowed to the appellants, in full and final settlement of the claim in this appeal.
As per the statement of learned counsel for the appellants the said amount be paid to appellant No.1-Krishna Devi.

We dispose of this case with a direction to Insurance Company to deposit a crossed-cheque in the sum of Rs.1,50,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Fifty Thousand only) in the name of appellant No.1-Krishna Devi with the office of the Lok Adalat of the High Court on or before 24.03.2025 failing which the amount will carry 9% interest p.a. from the date of this order till the cheque is deposited with the office of the Lok Adalat.
The appellants' counsel/appellants may collect the cheque from the office of the Lok Adalat.
